name: Seed Nutrition with Curcumin
summary: A seed milk powder combining **95% pure Curcumin**, seaweed and **15 macrobiotic seeds and grains**. Sweetened with stevia, with a rich, nutty taste that is easy to drink – a gentle snack for the whole family.

sections.title: Ingredients
sections.text: 95% pure Curcumin, seaweed, 15 seeds/grains: macadamia, lotus seeds, oats, walnuts, chia seeds, pumpkin seeds, corn, green peas, sacha inchi, brown rice, black sesame, almonds, mung beans, red beans, chickpeas. Plus non-dairy creamer, maltodextrin, Stevinten fresh (stevia) and vanilla flavor.

sections.title: Why choose it
items: Curcumin extracted from Vietnamese turmeric using technology from the Vietnam Institute of Industrial Chemistry.
A blend of seeds rich in plant protein, healthy fats, vitamins and minerals.
Adds nutrition to your snack, supports digestion and provides antioxidants.
Genuine Vietnamese product with quality documents, verifiable via iCheck.

sections.title: Who it's for
sections.text: Children aged 3 and up; older adults; people with sensitive digestion; people who want to rebuild their strength, including after being unwell; people watching their weight; vegetarians and vegans.

sections.title: How to use
sections.text:
**To prepare:** stir 3 scoops of powder (about 30g) into 150–180ml of warm water at 60–70°C.

**Serving:** one 180ml glass, 2–3 times a day.

If you're new to it, start with half a serving and increase gradually so your body can get used to the fiber.

sections.title: Storage
items: Unopened: keep in a cool place away from sunlight. Shelf life 24 months.
Opened: close tightly and use within 30 days.

sections.title: Origin
sections.text: Genuine product of Vietnam. Responsible for quality: Vitanuts Green Nutrition JSC. The factory meets food hygiene and safety standards.

disclaimer: This product is not a medicine and does not replace medical treatment.
